name: OCCITANIE
tagline: Cabrette, vielle, galoubet, mandoline, accordion, choir and bells with a built-in drone: 70 presets.
sub: Folk instruments of Southern France, with drone
gumroad_title: OCCITANIE - Occitan Folk Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Folk, Afrotrap, Cinematic, World
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (Cabrette, Vielle, Galoubet, Mandoline, Guitare, Accordeon, Choeur and Carillon) and 70 factory presets.
about: OCCITANIE, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines (Cabrette, Vielle, Galoubet, Mandoline, Guitare, Accordeon, Choeur and Carillon), shape it with five character controls (REED, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb. A DRONE control adds a soft tone one octave below each note on any engine, the classic bagpipe and hurdy-gurdy sound.
67 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode and 3 in Mono mode, so you can play chords or single-note lines from the first preset.
Built for Oriental and Rai melodies, Afrotrap and Drill plucked hooks, cinematic Trap intros, medieval and world music, folk-flavoured Hip-Hop loops and Deep House toplines.

features.d: Cabrette (bagpipe), Vielle (hurdy-gurdy), Galoubet (pipe), Mandoline, Guitare, Accordeon, Choeur (choir) and Carillon (bells).
REED, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from bagpipe, hurdy-gurdy and pipes to plucked strings, musette accordion, choirs and carillons.
A DRONE control adds a soft tone one octave below each note, on any engine.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with the cutoff following the keyboard.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: OCCITANIE plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.
No. Every sound is generated in real time by one of eight synthesis engines.

faq.q: What does the DRONE control do?
faq.a: It adds a softened saw one octave below each note you play, on every engine. It follows the melody and stops with the note.
No. Shape the sound over time with the volume envelope and the LFO.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .occpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
No. The plugin reports 0 samples of latency.
